name: Gets a list of recurring_quotes
description:
Lists recurring_quotes, search and filters allow fine grained lists to be generated.

        Query parameters can be added to performed more fine grained filtering of the recurring_quotes, these are handled by the RecurringQuoteFilters class which defines the methods available
whenToUse: List or filter many recurring quotes with search, sort, and pagination; use when browsing or finding recurring quotes rather than fetching one by id.

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

queryParameters.name: per_page
queryParameters.description: The number of records to return for each request, default is 20

queryParameters.name: page
queryParameters.description: The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1

queryParameters.name: sort
queryParameters.description:
Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column|asc` or `column|desc`.

*Single sort** — for example `sort=next_send_date|desc`.

*Multiple sorts** — for example
`sort[]=number|asc&sort[]=id|desc`.

Recurring quotes use their table columns and related sorts from `RecurringQuoteFilters`. Unsupported keys are ignored.
